message: Hi, I'm a student with a hadoop certification background. My overall academic average is 81.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in parallel computing and testing. I want to become a Solutions Architect. My family can afford at most about USD 1500 per year. I live in Pune. I'm open to anywhere in India.

other_constraints: interested in parallel computing and testing

reflection_note: The current shortlist is heavily biased towards QA testing or operational support (PR0080, PR0190, PR0187), which are suboptimal for a Solutions Architect goal. Only PR0019 provides the necessary general Software Engineering foundation. I have dropped all other options due to either severe career mismatch (PR0187) or excessive specialization/lack of breadth (PR0080, PR0190). Since there is only one strong option, I will keep it and recommend adding 2-3 more diverse programs that focus on cloud architecture, distributed systems, or general enterprise computing to provide a balanced shortlist for the student.
explanation:
Ashford University
This program was recommended because it perfectly aligns with your location preference in Pune and stays within your maximum budget of $1500 USD, costing only $1450 annually. Academically, your 81.8% grade easily surpasses the minimum requirement of 64%, and the curriculum fields—Software Engineering and QA Testing—directly address your interest in testing. The program offers a high placement rate of 84% with a median starting salary of $10285 USD. The main trade-off to note is that it provides zero months of post-study work visa support.
